scope: finite controls and necessary-condition checks; not BQG physical history

constant_mass_mixing.scope: positive kinetic metric, flat quadratic two-field model

extra_spatial_dimensions.compact_circle: k_n=n/R; illustrative discrete eigenvalue 4/a_y^2 sin^2(pi*n/N_y), not derived from BQG

finite_hermitian_2T.assumptions: finite dimension, positive inner product, self-adjoint Q11,Q12,Q22, exact Sp(2,R) commutators
finite_hermitian_2T.proof: Tr(Q11[Q11,Q12])=0=2i*hbar*Tr(Q11^2), hence Q11=0; remaining relations imply Q12=Q22=0
finite_hermitian_2T.escape_conditions: infinite-dimensional/domain limit or different parent construction; finite abstract non-Hermitian sl2 matrices do not evade these assumptions
